$comment: #EXP-1732 (EDE-63, owner 2026-11-07; drafts c13140f9 session, ff3f91ca agent, de58c149 app) THE SESSION SCREEN ×4: ONE screen for a chat (a root session), a team agent's conversation, the Assistant's and an app's editor session (an app IS its agent's session); the list and the sidebar entry stay `Chats` (chats.json). AMENDS session-chat.json (the strip: `+`, Conversation, issue/session chips, the group tab, the plan tab, the pinned Results tab are GONE ×4; the chip strip is deleted, not hidden), chats.json `agentChat.tabs/planTabs/pageCases` (an agent's chat gets the same tabs) and apps.json THE EDITOR's `editorTabs` (wide/phone/menu tab sets: the app gets this screen's tabs; Versions is a tab, Settings is the gear). HEADER (every width, every kind): the lead avatar (a chat: THE ChatHeaderTitle lead disc; an agent: its disc, the Assistant: THE brand mark; an app: its BoardGlyph + the version pill), the title (one truncated line) over ONE subtitle line `subtitle({status, device, trigger})` = the non-blank parts joined by `copy.separator` (status = the session's state word, device = its device's name, trigger = an agent's first enabled trigger's `triggerSummary`, else null); then the trailing slot: the merge status pill (merge-train.json, while `guidePullRequest`), an app's Publish (apps.json), THE gear (`gear`: the existing icon button, concept `nav-settings`, label `copy.settings`, testId `testIds.gear`), the `…` (THE chat menu / agent menu / app menu: Export, Delete; Versions and Settings left it). UNDER the header row, on every width: ONE SegmentedControl (THE existing one ×4 + Exponential UI, no new component), testId `testIds.tabs`, its options = `tabs` in order, each the label `copy.tabs[id]` followed by its `count` as a muted number when not null; on a phone it scrolls sideways when it overflows (never icon-only, never wrapping). TABS BY KIND (`kinds`): a chat, an agent and the Assistant = chat · issues · sessions · results; an app = chat · preview · data · versions · sessions · results. COUNTS (`count`, issues/sessions/results only; 0 = null): issues = every issue of the tree (session-chat.json's union, nested ones included), sessions = every session UNDER the root (its children and theirs; #EXP-1731's subagent children included; the root itself never), results = results-tab.json's results of the tree. GEAR (`gear`): agent, assistant and app; never a chat. It opens the kind's SETTINGS as an opened item (`open: settings`): an agent = THE agent settings page (agent-settings.json: prompt, triggers, defaults; the Assistant's = settings/assistant), an app = the app's settings page (apps.json Settings, the app's agent's prompt/triggers/defaults on the same page once apps.agent_id lands, #EXP-1730). BODIES: chat = THE ONE transcript (#EXP-1736 transcript-grouping.json: MessageBubble + avatar + name for EVERY kind; no second message view anywhere) + THE Dock + THE composer; plans and questions stay INLINE in it (and in Needs you); a plan row opens the plan page (plan-page.json) as an opened item. issues = the tree's issues as THE issue rows (status glyph, mono identifier, title; nested ones indented under their parent), led by the `+` icon button (THE Menu: Link an issue > THE search list, New issue); a row opens that issue IN PLACE (`open: issue`, the embedded issue body of session-chat.json EXP-1316). sessions = THE tree rows of every session under the root (SessionRow small + TreeGuides, markState, subagents included as child rows); a row opens that session IN PLACE (`open: session`, the raw work + its composer). results = results-tab.json's body. preview / data / versions = apps.json's Preview, Data (app-records.json `dataTab`) and Versions bodies. An OPENED item (issue, session, plan, settings) carries a `‹` back to the tab it came from (settings and a plan: back to where they were opened). LAYOUT (`sessionScreen`, every mirror replays `cases` comparing the WHOLE value): WIDE (web ≥ `beside.breakpoint` px and the IDE) = the beside rule: whenever the active tab is not chat OR an item is opened, the body = TWO panes, the chat pane (`beside.chat` fr, min `beside.chatMinWidth` px, THE same chat body with its composer) : the tab pane (`beside.pane` fr, the active tab's body, or the opened item over it), a hairline between (`layout: beside`, testId `testIds.beside`); the Chat tab alone = the chat full width (`layout: chat`). NARROW (phones, web < breakpoint) = ONE pane: `chat`, the tab's body (`tab`) or the opened item (`item`, a pushed page over the tab). ACTIVE = the requested tab when it is one of the kind's tabs (legacy `?tab=` values map through `legacyTabs` first), else the kind's default: an app `preview` when wide (apps.json), else `chat`. OPEN (`open` in: issue | session | plan | settings, anything else = null): a requested `settings` (the retired app `?tab=settings`) opens settings when nothing else is open; settings only with `gear` (else null). ALGORITHM: k = `kinds[kind]` (unknown = session); tabs = k.tabs as {id, label, count}; req = `legacyTabs[requested]` ?? requested; active = req when in k.tabs, else (wide ? k.wideDefault : `chat`); layout = wide ? (active ≠ chat or open ? `beside` : `chat`) : (open ? `item` : active = chat ? `chat` : `tab`). Mirrors: TS src/session-screen.ts, desktop `domain::session_screen`, iOS ExpCore `SessionScreen.swift`, Android `domain/SessionScreen.kt`.
